integrity: General theorem proved symbolically via term functions, local operator interpolation and the Chinese remainder theorem; direct independent-in-method finite consistency checks are supplied. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Does not cover arbitrary multiple Jordan blocks, non-unipotent actions, or infinite base fields. An older paper on free polynilpotent Lie identities remains a possible source of implicit equivalent coverage. Finite tests are not proofs beyond their enumerated parameters.
scientific_scope: For every prime power q, every Jordan length s>=2 and every free rank n>=1, a single unipotent Jordan block action in a finite-field almost-abelian Lie algebra.
title: Exact free-rank dimensions and separating identities for Jordan-extended affine Lie algebras
